event_as_printed: First Statement – Confirmed that whilst 2 generators had disconnected the system was now functioning properly.
distribution_as_printed: Published on twitter @NG_ESO and sent to all national energy correspondents, and national print, TV and Radio newsdesks. Shared with BEIS and Ofgem.

event_as_printed: Second statement – Explained why there had been a power cut and confirmed again that the system had been restored at an NTS and DNO level.
distribution_as_printed: Published on twitter @NG_ESO and sent to all national energy correspondents, and national print, TV and Radio newsdesks. Shared with BEIS and Ofgem.

event_as_printed: A video from [the Head of National Control] offering further explanation issued on Twitter.
Broadcast interviews – Radio 4 Today Programme, Five Live, ITV, BBC Breakfast and Sky.
Third Statement – Further explanation of events and clarification that National Grid does not generate electricity.
distribution_as_printed: Published on Twitter @NG_ESO and to all national energy correspondents, and national print, TV and Radio news desks. Shared with BEIS and Ofgem.

event_as_printed: Fourth Statement – Expressed support for Energy Emergency Executive Committee investigation and highlighted that ESO was in process of internal investigation.
distribution_as_printed: Published on Twitter @NG_ESO and to all national energy correspondents, and national print, TV and Radio news desks. Shared with BEIS and Ofgem.

ESO Media team direct engagement with ENA and relevant members. Setting out preliminary technical findings related to the networks and discussing the planned approach to media and communications ahead of publication of the Interim Report.
